text: 近期，多家银行上调美元定期存款利率。记者梳理发现，目前市场上美元定期存款利率整体走高，部分产品利率突破4%，收益显著高于同期限人民币存款。大众银行深圳分行公布的11月2日至11月6日美元定期存款参考利率表显示，该行12个月美元定期存款利率最高可达4.2%；3个月、6个月的美元定期存款利率也均在4%以上。而在9月份，该行12个月美元定期存款利率最高为3.9%。根据东亚银行的“东亚中国财富管理”微信公众号10月31日公告，新客在该行选择1万美元（含）至5万美元（不含）档位办理美元定期存款，3个月、6个月和12个月最高利率分别可达3.4%、3.4%和3.35%
text_en: Recently, several banks have raised their US dollar time deposit rates. A review by reporters found that US dollar time deposit rates in the market are generally rising, with some product rates exceeding 4%, significantly higher than RMB deposits of the same tenor. The reference rate table for US dollar time deposits from November 2 to November 6 published by Public Bank Shenzhen Branch shows that the bank's 12-month US dollar time deposit rate can reach as high as 4.2%; the 3-month and 6-month US dollar time deposit rates are also both above 4%. In September, the bank's maximum 12-month US dollar time deposit rate was 3.9%. According to an announcement on October 31 on Bank of East Asia's "BEA China Wealth Management" WeChat official account, new customers who choose a US dollar time deposit tier of $10,000 (inclusive) to $50,000 (exclusive) at the bank can receive maximum rates of 3.4%, 3.4% and 3.35% for 3-month, 6-month and 12-month deposits, respectively
